content.description: claimr is a white label engagement platform that helps teams launch quests, rewards, leaderboards, tiers, and referral systems without building the mechanics from scratch. Its official site positions the product as a plug and play growth stack for community activation, retention, and loyalty, with modules that support both onchain and offchain actions. The platform is aimed at products that want campaign control and analytics from one dashboard rather than separate quest, reward, and CRM tools. On Mantle, it fits as growth infrastructure for teams running incentive and loyalty programs around users.
